newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to cut May oil product wholesale prices.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to cut May oil product wholesale prices.

text.p: Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Monday it would lower its oil product wholesale prices by 0.7 yen per litre effective from May 1, reflecting weaker global crude oil prices.
The decline, for the second consecutive month, will bring the wholesale price for gasoline down to 90.5 yen per litre and that for gas oil to 68.8 yen per litre, both including tax.
Kerosene, which is not taxed at the wholesale stage, will be 36.7 yen per litre.

Major Japanese refiners review their wholesale prices on a monthly basis, and adjust their prices according to movements in global crude oil and petroleum product markets, as well as the currency market.
